```sql
WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        tag
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(coupon_codes) e AS tag
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS created_at_label
    FROM exploded
    WHERE created_at > DATE '2025-03-01'
      AND tag IS DISTINCT FROM 'VIP'
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.customer_id,
        e.tag,
        d.segment,
        d.name
    FROM cleaned e
    LEFT JOIN customers d
        ON e.customer_id <=> d.id
    WHERE d.is_active
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT e.*, d.signup_date
    FROM with_dims e
    LEFT JOIN customers d
        ON e.customer_id = d.id
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', signup_date) AS quarter_start,
        customer_id,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(segment)) AS segment_list,
        COUNT_IF(segment = 'Corporate') AS corporate_events,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN segment = 'Corporate' THEN 1 END) AS corporate_count,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(tag)) AS num_tags,
        GROUPING_ID() AS gid
    FROM enriched
    GROUP BY CUBE (DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', signup_date), customer_id)
)
SELECT
    s.quarter_start,
    s.customer_id,
    s.segment_list,
    s.corporate_events,
    s.num_tags,
    s.gid,
    (SELECT MIN(s2.monthly_fee) FROM subscriptions s2 WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS min_subscription_monthly_fee
FROM grouped s
ORDER BY min_subscription_monthly_fee DESC NULLS LAST, gid DESC;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

monthly_fee_by_customer_id = df_subscriptions.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.min("monthly_fee").alias("min_subscription_monthly_fee"))

exploded = (
    df_carts
    .select("id", "customer_id", "created_at", F.explode("coupon_codes").alias("tag"))
)

cleaned = (
    exploded
    .filter((F.col("created_at") > F.lit("2025-03-01").cast("date")) & (~F.col("tag").eqNullSafe(F.lit("VIP"))))
    .withColumn("created_at_label", F.date_format("created_at", "yyyy-MM"))
)

with_dims = (
    cleaned
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("e.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("d.id")), "left")
    .filter(F.col("d.is_active"))
    .select("e.id", "e.customer_id", "e.tag", F.col("d.segment"), F.col("d.name"))
)

enriched = (
    with_dims
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("d.signup_date"))
)

grouped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "signup_date"))
    .cube("quarter_start", "customer_id")
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("segment")).alias("segment_list"),
        F.count_if(F.col("segment") == "Corporate").alias("corporate_events"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Corporate", 1)).alias("corporate_count"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("tag")).alias("num_tags"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
)

result = (
    grouped
    .join(monthly_fee_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "quarter_start",
        "customer_id",
        "segment_list",
        "corporate_events",
        "num_tags",
        "gid",
        F.col("min_subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("min_subscription_monthly_fee").desc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("gid").desc(),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        CASE WHEN quantity >= 260 THEN 'High' WHEN quantity >= 100 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS quantity_level
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock > TO_DATE('2023-03-31')
      AND quantity BETWEEN 98 AND 127
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY quantity DESC, id) AS quantity_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock, id) AS seq_no
    FROM valid
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(quantity_bucket) OVER w_running AS last4_min_quantity_bucket,
        MAX(quantity_bucket) OVER w_running AS last4_max_quantity_bucket,
        COUNT(quantity_bucket) OVER w_running AS last4_count_quantity_bucket,
        SUM(quantity_bucket) OVER w_running AS last4_sum_quantity_bucket,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY row_seq, id) AS row_seq_bucket
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
valid_inventory AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        last_restock,
        quantity_level,
        quantity_bucket,
        row_seq,
        seq_no,
        last4_count_quantity_bucket,
        last4_sum_quantity_bucket,
        row_seq_bucket,
        CEIL(row_seq_bucket) AS row_seq_bucket_whole
    FROM metrics
    WHERE row_seq_bucket BETWEEN 5 AND 7
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT store_id
    FROM valid_inventory
    INTERSECT
    SELECT store_id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE quantity < 68
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid_inventory s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.store_id = k.store_id
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.store_id,
    s.quantity_level,
    s.quantity_bucket,
    s.row_seq,
    s.seq_no,
    s.last4_sum_quantity_bucket,
    s.row_seq_bucket,
    s.row_seq_bucket_whole,
    (SELECT MIN(t2.amount) FROM orders t2 WHERE t2.store_id = s.store_id) AS min_order_amount
FROM reconciled s;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
amount_by_store_id = df_orders.groupBy("store_id").agg(F.min("amount").alias("min_order_amount"))

valid = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-31"))) & F.col("quantity").between(98, 127))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 260, "High").when(F.col("quantity") >= 100, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("quantity_level"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .withColumn("quantity_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id")))
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("quantity_bucket").over(w_running).alias("last4_min_quantity_bucket"),
        F.max("quantity_bucket").over(w_running).alias("last4_max_quantity_bucket"),
        F.count("quantity_bucket").over(w_running).alias("last4_count_quantity_bucket"),
        F.sum("quantity_bucket").over(w_running).alias("last4_sum_quantity_bucket"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy("row_seq", "id")).alias("row_seq_bucket"),
    )
)

valid_inventory = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("row_seq_bucket").between(5, 7))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        "quantity_level",
        "quantity_bucket",
        "row_seq",
        "seq_no",
        "last4_count_quantity_bucket",
        "last4_sum_quantity_bucket",
        "row_seq_bucket",
        F.ceil("row_seq_bucket").alias("row_seq_bucket_whole"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    valid_inventory
    .select("store_id")
    .intersect(
        df_inventory
        .filter(F.col("quantity") < 68)
        .select("store_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    valid_inventory
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .join(amount_by_store_id, on="store_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "quantity_level",
        "quantity_bucket",
        "row_seq",
        "seq_no",
        "last4_sum_quantity_bucket",
        "row_seq_bucket",
        "row_seq_bucket_whole",
        F.col("min_order_amount"),
    )
)
```

```sql
with with_dims as (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    select e.*, s.country
    from web_events e
    join sessions s
        on e.session_id = s.id
),
ranked as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by session_id order by event_time desc nulls last, id) as rank_in_group
        from with_dims
    ) ranked
    where rank_in_group = 1
),
joined as (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    select
        s.id,
        s.session_id,
        s.event_type,
        s.event_time,
        s.duration_sec,
        s.country,
        d.device
    from ranked s
    left join sessions d
        on s.session_id = d.id
    where d.browser = 'Firefox'
),
flagged as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(event_time) over (partition by device order by event_time, id) is null
                 or event_time > lag(event_time) over (partition by device order by event_time, id) + interval 60 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from joined
),
sessions_web_events as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by device order by event_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_no
    from flagged
),
latest as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        country,
        is_new_session,
        session_no
    from sessions_web_events
    qualify rank() over (partition by country order by is_new_session desc nulls last) = 1
)
select
    s.id,
    s.session_id,
    s.event_type,
    s.event_time,
    s.duration_sec,
    s.country,
    s.is_new_session,
    s.session_no,
    case when country rlike '^(SG|UK)$' then 'OTHER_ZONE' else 'EXTENDED' end as country_zone,
    (select max(x.duration_sec) from web_events x where x.session_id = s.session_id) as max_web_event_duration_sec
from latest s
order by id desc nulls last, session_no desc
limit 5
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        txn_time_day,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT

        LENGTH(txn_type) AS txn_type_length,

    FROM cleaned
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_txn_time IS NULL OR txn_time > prev_txn_time + INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM prev_events
),
islands_transactions AS (

    SELECT

        txn_type_length,
```

```sql
with_last AS (

    SELECT

        s.tier_section,
        s.ticket_px,
        s.announced_date,
        x.merch_revenue,
        x.setlist_announced_on

            SELECT c.merch_revenue, c.announced_on AS setlist_announced_on
            FROM setlists c
            WHERE c.concert_no = s.id
            ORDER BY c.merch_revenue DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tier_section ORDER BY merch_revenue DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM with_last
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
base AS (

    SELECT *, MONTH(announced_date) AS announced_date_month
    FROM ranked
    WHERE tier_section IS NOT NULL

scored AS (

        id,

        merch_revenue,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tier_section ORDER BY rank_in_group, id) AS event_seq,
        SUM(announced_date_month) OVER (PARTITION BY tier_section ORDER BY setlist_announced_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_announced_date_month
    FROM base
)
```

```python
w_running = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "order_status").orderBy(F.col("amount_int").desc(), "id")
w_grp_2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("order_amount", "id")

    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
```

```sql
    (SELECT AVG(o2.amount) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS avg_order_amount
FROM daily s
ORDER BY balance_tier DESC;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

amount_by_customer_id = df_orders.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.avg("amount").alias("avg_order_amount"))

filtered = (
    df_accounts
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") > F.lit("2023-09-17").cast("date")) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("abs_balance", F.abs("balance"))
    .withColumn("status_clean", F.coalesce("status", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

latest = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy(F.col("abs_balance").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

deduped = (
    latest
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("abs_balance").asc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

with_dims = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.account_type",
        "s.balance",
        "s.abs_balance",
        F.col("c.age"),
    )
)

deduped_accounts = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy(F.col("age").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "customer_id", "balance", "age")
)

daily = (
    deduped_accounts
    .groupBy(
        "customer_id",
        F.when(F.col("balance") >= 85000, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("balance_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("customer_id").alias("distinct_customer_ids"),
        F.stddev_samp("balance").alias("balance_stddev"),
        F.round(F.avg("balance"), 2).alias("avg_balance"),
        F.min("balance").alias("min_balance"),
        F.sum("age").alias("total_age"),
        F.percentile_approx("age", 0.95).alias("age_p95"),

    .withColumn("total_age_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("total_age").desc())))
)

result = (

        "balance_stddev",
        "min_balance",
        "total_age",
        "total_age_percent_rank",
        F.col("avg_order_amount"),

    .orderBy(F.col("balance_tier").desc())
```
